## Analysis

`sol_0010` directly tested the proposed controlled-carry mechanism and found no improvement, so overlapping two-digit products are not sufficient in the explored regime. Five consecutive failures across periodic, fringe, grid, and carry-based representations indicate that large exact-score annealing is repeatedly trapped at the same width-4 construction. The strongest gain came from changing the structural family (`sol_0003` to `sol_0004`), not refining a fixed family. Wider one-dimensional periodic residue patterns remain insufficiently explored: prior periodic searches used widths only 3–8, while the 2D grid experiment was carry-free and therefore does not cover ordinary modular interval constructions.
